feed.title: MTG Kernel Weekly
feed.subtitle: A computer program learning Magic: The Gathering by playing games against itself and earlier bots. Follow its progress one chart a week.

entry.title: #2: A new top bot, a search miss, and Vintage Cube's first run
entry.summary: Basilisk 3 took first place on the Spellbench Pauper leaderboard at 1,619.5 Elo, lookahead search missed in a 900-decision screen, and Vintage Cube finished its first shakedown under random play.

entry.title: #1: A bot that taught itself Magic is still getting better
entry.summary: A Magic: The Gathering bot won about 71 in 100 games against its starting version after 1.59 million training steps.
